name: Judge Human First Plan
description: Prioritize future queue top-ups toward answered human judgment pairs while preserving deterministic local SQLite ready ordering, legacy job DB upgrade safety, and existing ready-row semantics.

userStories.title: Make SQLite ready claims use deterministic enqueue order
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want `queue_prompt` ready claims to use an explicit enqueue sequence so newly inserted ready rows are claimed deterministically without changing the order of existing ready rows or requeued rows.
acceptanceCriteria: Add an explicit monotonic enqueue-order column for `queue_prompt`, such as `ready_insert_seq`, and assign it once when rows are first inserted into `ready`.
`claimReadyPrompts` orders ready rows by the explicit enqueue-order column instead of relying on tied `created_at` timestamps and UUID tie-breaking.

Status transitions including claim, judgment success, and requeue do not rewrite the enqueue-order value, so stale sent rows returning to `ready` keep their prior queue position relative to newer rows.
Update the SQLite ready-claim index and any queue-order validation that assumed `(created_at, id)` ordering to use the explicit enqueue-order column.
`bun test src/server/cron/judgmentsJobs/judgmentJobSqliteService.test.ts` passes
`bun test src/server/cron/judgmentsJobs/judgmentsJobsAddToQueue.test.ts` passes
`bun test src/server/cron/judgmentsJobs/judgmentsJobsSendToLLM/getAndUpdateReadyPrompts.test.ts` passes
`bun test src/server/cron/judgmentsJobs/requeueAbandonedSentPrompts.test.ts` passes
`bun run lint` passes
userStories.notes: Preserve deterministic SQLite ready ordering and requeue order preservation. Do not reshuffle rows already queued in local SQLite beyond replacing non-deterministic tie-breaking with explicit FIFO behavior.

userStories.title: Upgrade legacy SQLite job DBs without changing effective ready order
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want existing judgment job SQLite files to upgrade in place so the new enqueue-order column is backfilled safely without losing rows or changing the effective FIFO order of already queued work.
acceptanceCriteria: Add an in-place schema upgrade for legacy `queue_prompt` tables, following the existing local SQLite upgrade patterns already used for other job tables.
Backfill enqueue-order values for existing `queue_prompt` rows in current `(created_at, id)` order so legacy ready rows keep their effective FIFO order after upgrade.
Isolated preflight or readonly validation upgrades legacy `queue_prompt` schema before validating required columns and queue ordering assumptions.
Legacy SQLite job DB upgrades keep all queue rows intact and do not change the effective order of existing ready rows.
`bun test src/server/cron/judgmentsJobs/judgmentJobSqliteService.test.ts` passes
`bun test src/server/cron/judgmentsJobs/judgmentsJobsAddToQueue.test.ts` passes
`bun test src/server/cron/judgmentsJobs/judgmentsJobsSendToLLM/getAndUpdateReadyPrompts.test.ts` passes
`bun test src/server/cron/judgmentsJobs/requeueAbandonedSentPrompts.test.ts` passes
`bun run lint` passes
userStories.notes: Preserve legacy DB upgrade safety. Existing queued rows must remain stable, and readonly or preflight checks must not fail simply because the DB predates the new column.

userStories.title: Prioritize answered human pairs at the queue add boundary
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want `judgmentsJobsAddToQueue` to prefer fetched `(articleId, promptId)` pairs with answered human rows for the same project so future top-ups become human-first without changing OLAP ordering or scan cursor semantics.
acceptanceCriteria: Add a helper in `judgmentsJobsAddToQueue.ts` that batches fetched prompt pairs and queries `app.judgment_human` for `project_id = job.projectId` and `is_answered = TRUE` using the existing pair-CTE style.
Keep existing `filterAlreadyJudged` behavior, then stable-partition the fetched-and-filtered window into `humanFirst` and `rest` while preserving original order inside each group.
Pass `[...humanFirst, ...rest]` into `addReadyPrompts` so human-touched pairs become visible in actual SQLite ready insertion and claim order for new rows when `readyDeficit` trims the window.
Prioritization remains window-local only: it does not change OLAP candidate ordering, scan cursor semantics, or the order of rows already present in local SQLite `ready`.
Unanswered human rows, cross-project human rows, already judged rows, and locally judged SQLite rows do not gain priority or bypass existing filtering rules.

Add minimal observability that logs non-zero human-first candidates in the fetched window and how many of those candidates were actually inserted after `readyDeficit` trimming and `INSERT OR IGNORE` dedupe.
`bun test src/server/cron/judgmentsJobs/judgmentJobSqliteService.test.ts` passes
`bun test src/server/cron/judgmentsJobs/judgmentsJobsAddToQueue.test.ts` passes
`bun test src/server/cron/judgmentsJobs/judgmentsJobsSendToLLM/getAndUpdateReadyPrompts.test.ts` passes
`bun test src/server/cron/judgmentsJobs/requeueAbandonedSentPrompts.test.ts` passes
`bun run lint` passes
userStories.notes: Preserve human-first window-local prioritization. This change applies only to future top-ups, uses `app.judgment_human.is_answered = TRUE` as the signal, and must not require non-empty `answer` content or involve `app.judgment_assessment`.

userStories.title: Lock the behavior with ordering and prioritization regression tests
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want targeted regression coverage for deterministic queue ordering, legacy upgrade safety, and human-first top-ups so future changes cannot silently reintroduce queue-order or prioritization regressions.
acceptanceCriteria: Add SQLite service coverage proving a fresh job DB preserves insertion order through `claimReadyPrompts` and that requeueing stale sent rows back to `ready` does not rewrite enqueue order.

Add legacy upgrade coverage proving a legacy `queue_prompt` schema is upgraded in place, enqueue order is backfilled without losing rows, and isolated preflight upgrades the schema before readonly validation.

Add top-up coverage proving end-to-end `judgmentsJobsAddToQueue -> addReadyPrompts -> claimReadyPrompts` behavior when `readyDeficit` is smaller than the fetched window and a human-answered pair appears later than non-human pairs in scan order.
Add top-up coverage proving multiple promoted human pairs preserve their original relative order and that unanswered, cross-project, already-judged, and locally judged rows do not receive priority.
Update or add `getAndUpdateReadyPrompts` coverage so tests assert returned prompt order directly rather than sorting results and masking queue-order regressions.

Add requeue coverage proving rows already in `status = 'ready'` still claim ahead of newly inserted human-first rows and stale sent rows moved back to `ready` preserve original queue position relative to newer rows.
